prompts.name: mmh-kbeauty
prompts.prompt: Create a premium, science-led Korean-skincare hero shot: the foundation bottle standing upright on a clean off-white surface in a bright, airy, minimalist lab-meets-spa setting (clinical but warm, exclusive). A soft swatch of the white cream sits beside the base, catching the light with a fresh, dewy 'glass-skin' sheen. Subtle frosted-glass and pale neutral tones in the softly blurred background suggest a Korean skincare laboratory. Soft diffused daylight, gentle reflections, lots of calm negative space. Clean, high-end, hydrating, glowy mood — feels like advanced skincare, not makeup-aisle cosmetics.
